props.gloss_en: the Men of the Great Assembly instituted for Israel blessings and prayers, kedushot and havdalot
Rav Shemen bar Abba: let us see where they instituted [it]
at first they fixed it [havdala] in the prayer
they grew rich -- they fixed it over the cup
they grew poor -- they fixed it again in the prayer
and they said: one who says havdala in the prayer must say havdala over the cup
one who erred and did not mention the might of the rains in the resurrection blessing -- we send him back
and [one who omitted] the request in the blessing of the years -- we send him back
and [one who omitted] havdala in 'who graciously grants knowledge' -- we do not send him back
because he can say it over the cup
do not say 'because he can say it over the cup'; rather say 'because he says it over the cup'
one who said havdala over the cup -- what of his saying havdala in the prayer?
one who says havdala in the prayer is more praiseworthy than one who says it over the cup
and if he said havdala in this and in that, may blessings rest upon his head
so the prayer alone suffices [for havdala]
whoever says an unnecessary blessing transgresses on account of 'do not take [the Name of the Lord your God] in vain' (Ex 20:7)
rather say thus: if he said havdala in this and did not say it in that, may blessings rest upon his head
Rav Chisda: one who erred in this and in that -- what is [the rule]?
Rav Sheshet: one who erred in this and in that returns to the beginning
Ravina to Rava: what is the halakha?
as with kiddush: although one said kiddush in the prayer, he says kiddush over the cup
so havdala too: although one said havdala in the prayer, he says havdala over the cup

schemas.gloss_en: ומה תפלה דעיקר תקנתא היא, אמרי: המבדיל בתפלה צריך שיבדיל על הכוס -- המבדיל על הכוס, דלאו עיקר תקנתא היא, לא כל שכן! -- the prayer, the principal enactment, still requires havdala over the cup as well; the cup, not the principal enactment, all the more requires havdala in the prayer as well (premise: p_mavdil_batefila_kos)

supports.gloss_en: כי קידוש: מה קידוש אף על גב דמקדש בצלותא מקדש אכסא, אף הבדלה נמי -- havdala is like kiddush, which is said over the cup even after it was said in the prayer

objections.gloss_en: אמר רבא ומותבינן אשמעתין -- the tosefta does not send back one who omitted havdala in the prayer 'because he CAN say it over the cup': the cup is presented as an option, against the ruling that it is required

answered_by.gloss_en: לא תימא מפני שיכול לאומרה על הכוס, אלא אימא מפני שאומרה על הכוס -- read 'because he says it over the cup' (= p_emend_sheomrah_al_hakos)

objections.gloss_en: הא גופא קשיא -- the first clause implies the prayer alone suffices (אלמא תפלה לחודה סגי, = p_alma_tefilla_sagi); then once exempt by one, saying it in the other is a blessing that is not needed, which transgresses לא תשא -- how can the baraita bless one who says it in both?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אימא הכי: אם הבדיל בזו ולא הבדיל בזו ינוחו לו ברכות על ראשו (= p_emend_bezo_velo_bazo)

nodes.label_he: העשירו -- קבעוה על הכוס

nodes.label_he: העניו -- חזרו וקבעוה בתפלה

nodes.label_he: מפני שיכול לאומרה על הכוס
nodes.label_en: because he can say it over the cup

nodes.label_he: לא תימא מפני שיכול לאומרה על הכוס, אלא אימא מפני שאומרה על הכוס
nodes.label_en: do not say 'because he can say it over the cup'; rather say 'because he says it over the cup'

nodes.label_he: המבדיל על הכוס, מהו שיבדיל בתפלה?
nodes.label_en: one who said havdala over the cup -- what of his saying havdala in the prayer?

nodes.label_he: המבדיל בתפלה משובח יותר ממי שיבדיל על הכוס
nodes.label_en: one who says havdala in the prayer is more praiseworthy than one who says it over the cup

nodes.label_he: ואם הבדיל בזו ובזו -- ינוחו לו ברכות על ראשו
nodes.label_en: and if he said havdala in this and in that, may blessings rest upon his head

nodes.label_he: אלמא תפלה לחודה סגי
nodes.label_en: so the prayer alone suffices [for havdala]

nodes.label_he: כל המברך ברכה שאינה צריכה -- עובר משום לא תשא
nodes.label_en: whoever says an unnecessary blessing transgresses on account of 'do not take [the Name of the Lord…

nodes.label_he: אלא אימא הכי: אם הבדיל בזו ולא הבדיל בזו -- ינוחו לו ברכות על ראשו
nodes.label_en: rather say thus: if he said havdala in this and did not say it in that, may blessings rest upon his…

nodes.label_he: טעה בזו ובזו, מהו?
nodes.label_en: Rav Chisda: one who erred in this and in that -- what is [the rule]?

nodes.label_he: טעה בזו ובזו -- חוזר לראש
nodes.label_en: Rav Sheshet: one who erred in this and in that returns to the beginning

nodes.label_he: הלכתא מאי?
nodes.label_en: Ravina to Rava: what is the halakha?

nodes.label_he: מה קידוש, אף על גב דמקדש בצלותא מקדש אכסא
nodes.label_en: as with kiddush: although one said kiddush in the prayer, he says kiddush over the cup

nodes.label_he: אף הבדלה נמי, אף על גב דמבדיל בצלותא מבדיל אכסא
nodes.label_en: so havdala too: although one said havdala in the prayer, he says havdala over the cup
